name: design-os-pedagogy
description: Evidence-graded pedagogy library, cognitive-load curriculum tree runtime, and interactive mastery assessment engine for AI tutoring agents.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-graded pedagogy library, cognitive-load curriculum tree runtime, and interactive mastery assessment engine for AI tutoring agents.
interface.longDescription: Equip AI agents to teach complex technical subjects using Bloom's revised taxonomy, worked-example fading, spaced retrieval, Socratic diagnostic probes, and verifiable learner state machines.
defaultPrompt: Design a 5-stage mastery curriculum tree for distributed consensus (Raft) with prerequisite DAGs and diagnostic transfer questions.
Turn this codebase walkthrough into a worked-example fading sequence with interactive check-for-understanding probes.
Audit our onboarding tutorial for cognitive load violations, missing prerequisite links, and passive wall-of-text explanations.
